title: Jim Lacatski of the DIA, part of AAWSAP, writing about the program

tellings.quote: And then the weird thing is you have Jim Lacatski coming out, you know, who is is DIA rocket scientist involved in ASAP and he's now writing about this stuff

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to Jim Lacatski, a rocket scientist at the Defense Intelligence Agency, the Pentagon's military spy agency. Michels says Lacatski was involved in AAWSAP, a Pentagon-funded study of unexplained aerial and strange phenomena that began around 2008, and that he is now openly writing about this subject. Michels finds it striking because it would mean an insider is confirming the program's work in public.
